Appreciate the clear checklist. Looping in Rishi (solutions) and Mina (compliance) to provide the technical and contractual detail. Quick high-level answers while they prepare:
- Yes, we support EU-only processing for both hosted and private deployments — customers can pin to EU regions and we will route/serve exclusively from EU data centers.

Hi Anna —

Technical addendum from the solutions side:
- Region pinning: our routing layer allows per-customer and per-route region pin policies. For EU-only processing we pin both inference and any ephemeral cache/KV storage to eu-west-1 / eu-central-1 physical capacity.
- Network/data flow: control plane metadata (no customer content) may traverse our global control plane unless you select Private (VPC) deployment; for strict EU requirements we recommend Redwood Private with a customer-managed control plane or our EU-only private offering.
- Key management: customer-managed KMS is available; keys reside in your cloud tenant in the EU. We support HSM integration for on-prem customers.
- Backups & snapshots: by default we keep incremental backups; in enterprise agreements we add contractual commitments to delete backups within X days after deletion request and provide deletion attestations.

I attached a compact architecture diagram that highlights the EU-only flow and KMS boundaries.

If it helps, we can propose a mutual action plan to get SCCs signed and schedule a technical review with your infra/security team.

Cheers,
Rishi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Anna —

From a legal/compliance perspective:
- SCCs: Redwood executes the EU SCCs (2021 standard clauses) with customers as part of our DPA. We are prepared to sign the SCCs and to include supplementary technical and organizational measures (TOMs) as addenda where required. A draft SCC bundle is attached (SCCs_Redwood_v1.2.pdf).
- Schrems II considerations: we evaluate signals such as access by foreign public authorities and provide additional safeguards on a per-customer basis: customer-managed KMS, EU-only key storage, minimum disclosure policies, and logging/audit controls. For customers requiring the highest assurance, we offer our Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) which avoids cross-border transfers by design.
- Retention/deletion: default hosted retention windows are configurable via contract. We can commit to a deletion SLA (example: 7 days for primary stores, 30 days for backups to be overwritten) and provide an attestation report after deletion. Note that immutable logs required for security/compliance can be scoped separately.

I will run this through our legal sign-off team and can provide a redline-ready DPA + SCC package. Suggested next step: sign the attached DPA/SCC bundle and book a compliance call.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
